title: Ron Pressler - Pull Push: Please stop polluting our imperative languages with pure concepts-Curry On
summary: Ron Pressler's Curry On 2015 talk arguing that imperative languages should not be polluted with pure functional concepts like monads. He favors simple blocking code over non-blocking styles.
why: Recommended as the case for blocking code and virtual threads over monads and async/await.

quote.text: one of my recent favorite videos generally on this topic has been from Curry On conference
